bottomHtml:
Shop the best USB hubs and docking stations in Bangladesh at D CORE. Expand your device connectivity with high-quality USB-C hubs, multiport adapters, and docking stations designed for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.


Our collection includes a wide range of Type-C hubs, USB 3.0 hubs, HDMI hubs, and full-featured docking stations that support multiple ports such as USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, Ethernet (LAN), SD card readers, and Power Delivery (PD). These devices allow you to connect multiple peripherals through a single port, improving productivity and efficiency.


Whether you need a compact hub for travel or a powerful docking station for a professional workstation, D CORE offers reliable solutions with fast data transfer, stable performance, and wide compatibility. Ideal for office use, remote work, content creation, and multitasking setups.
